title: Run every logbook route and SQL invariant on the real platform
summary: The obsolete HTTP fake and in-memory SqlStorage shim are replaced by ten state-isolated route and ledger groups running the actual Worker, Durable Object SQLite, R2 and pinned signed OIDC issuer. Every meaningful old assertion is retained through the public API; runtime sources are unchanged. The original fake failure is a diagnostic of its unsupported conditional writes, not a product failure.
proves: pnpm exec vitest run --root packages/logbook --maxWorkers=1 passes all logbook checks, including the migrated public routes and ledger invariants plus the existing persisted-schema upgrade and restart checks. NX_DAEMON=false pnpm nx run-many -p logbook -t lint,typecheck --outputStyle=static passes. Every process and container owned by these tests is stopped.

captions.01-obsolete-fake-diagnostic: The obsolete HTTP fake fails its model-immutability assertion because its handwritten put ignores R2 conditional admission; this is a diagnostic, not a product failure.
captions.02-real-route-ledger-checks: All ten replacement groups pass on real workerd, SQLite Durable Objects, R2 and signed OIDC, before deleting either obsolete suite.
captions.03-static-checks: Targeted Nx lint and type checking pass for the logbook package.
captions.04-whole-logbook-suite: The whole logbook suite passes serially, including real persisted-schema upgrades and restarts.
captions.05-cleanup: No owned test ports, issuer containers or worktree Worker processes remain.
